rule: A sourced comparator row alone never counts as an MTS pass.
A small gamma/delta_p lane cannot pass while beta, preferred-frame, source, endpoint, readout or q_loc channels remain live.
Use componentwise absolute envelopes unless a parent identity proves exact cancellation.
A theorem-zero row is accepted only with parent-signed source/action path and no placeholder clauses.
A finite prediction row is accepted only with numeric value, units, source path, source anchor, and projection map.
Local GR/Newton reduction requires all local PPN/vector gates closed, not only the R_AB/gamma branch.
